text:
anya: Morning triage — quick snapshot: queue = 68 tickets (↑12 since last check). P1s = 3 (email-ingest, hosted-api-5xx, billing-sync). P2s ~ 14, remainder mostly onboarding/usage questions.

leah: I handled two onboarding ones already, dropped a macro on both. On email-ingest (#3421) the error looks like a downstream SMTP timeouts spike in eu-west; logs show repeated 421 responses. Escalating to infra if it doesn't clear in 20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: Taking hosted-api-5xx (ticket #3419) — saw a small deploy spike around 03:10 UTC, added the fallback policy and set an autoscale increase. Keeping an eye on error rate. I left a note to rollback if latency doesn't recover. :eyes:

sam: Billing-sync (ticket #3420) is a customer-facing P1 — schema mismatch when we ingest invoice batches. I posted the sample payload to the ticket and pinged payments eng. Priya, can you own follow-up with the customer for traces?

priya: On it, will reach out in 10m and attach logs. Also updating the "acknowledge" macro to add an ETA field. New macro snippet: 

```
/acknowledge
status: investigating
eta: 30m
contact: <support@redwood.ai>
```

anya: Thanks — can we also tweak the "escalate-p1" macro to include the oncall rotation link and requested SLO breach fields? Putting a draft in the macros doc: https://redwood.ai/internal/support/macros (please comment).

alert-bot: [incident] hosted-api-5xx error rate exceeded threshold (3xx -> 5xx ratio) — started 2026-03-16T03:10:12Z.

leah: Small ask — can someone glance at ticket #3407 (embedding mismatch) later today? It looks like a model version mismatch; leaving the analysis in the ticket but need eng confirmation.

mike: I can look post-standup (in ~30m). If it's model version pinning we should add a quick checklist to the macro for "version drift".

sam: Queue triage plan for next 2 hours: 1) stabilize P1s, 2) reduce P2 backlog by pushing quick replies and macros, 3) reassign any >48h tickets. Everyone mark any handoffs in the ticket comment thread.

anya: Operational notes: Overnight auto-ack rate was 21% (we aim for <15) — looks like some autoreplies triggered by doc-upload events. Will add a filter rule to macros to avoid auto-ack for doc-upload until we confirm.

priya: FYI — I've added a short form for ETA in customer replies so we don't miss follow-ups. Link to draft reply template: https://redwood.ai/internal/support/templates/eta-short.

leah: One more — can we get a volunteer to refresh the macro list in the runbook? A couple entries are stale. I can start but need someone to review. :thumbsup:

mike: I can review after my hosted-api check.

anya: Great. Current owners: hosted-api-5xx -> mike, email-ingest -> leah (with infra oncall loop), billing-sync -> sam+priya. We'll reconvene in 45m unless any P1s escalate. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
